fields.name: body
fields.label: Article body
fields.description: Written by the page generator when includeBody is on (Option A). Leave empty for Option B, where the browser fetches the body from the article endpoint.

fields.name: articleEndpoint
fields.label: Article JSON endpoint
fields.description: Overrides the default ArticleJsonServlet URL. Leave empty unless pointing the POC at another environment.

fields.name: articleBasePath
fields.label: Article base page
fields.description: Article-base page whose basePageSearchPaths drive the fragment lookup. Leave empty to use the configured default.
